title: Give every role an independently trained RLM identity

donor_sources.observation: ModelSpec binds static model settings to roles but has no trained-weight or adapter lineage.

mechanism: Role registry binds immutable root checkpoint, tokenizer, adapter, environment, curriculum and frozen-leaf identities.
challenge: A renamed base checkpoint or adapter for another role must not be accepted as a newly trained role model.

title: Implement the external-context RLM execution contract

donor_sources.observation: The cognitive program passes rendered conversation text into one model call; it does not implement external prompt state.

mechanism: Persistent context variables and programmatic recursion expose bounded observations and return Final by reference.
challenge: Huge stdout or a large final variable must not be copied into root history or truncated into the returned answer.

title: Train programmatic recursion within role boundaries

donor_sources.observation: The hierarchical swarm routes listed subtasks to workers; it is not a learned recursive REPL call policy.

mechanism: Role root adapters learn loop-generated recursive calls with immutable lineage and host-enforced role effects.
challenge: Programmatically generated child calls cannot request a broader role or escape the inherited capability set.

title: Export faithful root-turn training trajectories

donor_sources.observation: The donor records inference usage receipts but does not export token-faithful root-turn training examples.

mechanism: Exporter reconstructs each root prefix and one generated target while preserving observations and excluding child targets.
challenge: Flattening child assistant turns into root targets or including future observations must fail validation.

title: Distill only executable teacher trajectories

donor_sources.observation: The default optimizer metric rewards answer substrings rather than verified execution outcomes.

mechanism: Teacher RLM rollouts are replayed and filtered by an independent task oracle before root-adapter SFT.
challenge: A correct answer string with nonexecuting code or unverifiable tool results must not enter the accepted training set.

title: Align root SFT targets with actual token boundaries

donor_sources.observation: Program persistence saves DSPy program artifacts, not tokenizer-aligned root-model loss masks.

mechanism: Renderer-owned serialization assigns loss only to the selected root generation and validates tensor-level gradients.
challenge: Literal assistant markers inside tool output cannot acquire supervision or shift target masks.

title: Expose each role as a verifiable RLM environment

donor_sources.observation: The donor evaluates DSPy predictions with a callable metric rather than an isolated executable role environment.

mechanism: Version-pinned environment and harness adapters map role tasks to RLM episodes and immutable terminal oracles.
challenge: Generated code cannot edit grading files, and a zero-reward or failed episode cannot disappear from statistics.

title: Bridge role root datasets to actual Prime SFT jobs

donor_sources.observation: The wrappers optimize DSPy programs and do not launch neural root-model SFT.

mechanism: C-owned training manifests drive pinned prime-rl SFT with role-specific root targets and artifact validation.
challenge: Configuration-only success, unchanged tensors, or a trainer silently using messages instead of root targets must fail acceptance.

title: Train role roots with terminal verifiable rewards

donor_sources.observation: The evaluator uses heuristic coherence and model-produced scores rather than executable terminal rewards.

mechanism: Root-policy RL updates use immutable terminal rewards and root-only action attribution with frozen leaves.
challenge: Reward hacking, empty rollouts and timeouts cannot be scored as correct or yield fabricated optimizer progress.

title: Separate root and leaf learning credit experimentally

donor_sources.observation: The pipeline uses distinct root and leaf workers but has no factorial weight-training attribution experiment.

mechanism: Paired factorial evaluations isolate root-update, leaf-update and interaction effects on RLM outcomes.
challenge: A stronger leaf silently substituted after root training must not be credited to the root adapter.

title: Learn recursion depth and batching as root behavior

donor_sources.observation: Fanout and concurrency are configured ceilings rather than a trained context-dependent recursive policy.

mechanism: Root adapter learns when to recurse, how deeply and how to batch while the host enforces hard ceilings.
challenge: Blind maximum recursion or batching across dependent items loses correctness despite fewer model invocations.

title: Measure role RLM length generalization

donor_sources.observation: History is limited by turn count and per-turn character truncation, not evaluated for algorithmic length generalization.

mechanism: Train-short evaluate-long suites vary context length and semantic work independently with exact oracles.
challenge: Needles fixed at the same offsets or train/eval duplicates must not masquerade as length generalization.

title: Serve isolated role adapters by immutable version

donor_sources.observation: Static model normalization does not pin per-role trained adapters or prevent serving cross-contamination.

mechanism: Serving snapshots bind one role adapter to each recursive tree with explicit compatibility and update receipts.
challenge: Concurrent adapter reload cannot switch an in-flight tree or serve role A with role B weights.

title: Train interrole protocols against frozen partners

donor_sources.observation: Typed subtask and child-result schemas exist, but no role-specific neural protocol co-training loop.

mechanism: Alternating role-root updates learn useful typed messages against version-pinned partners and cross-play evaluation.
challenge: Partners colluding through leaked labels or changing together cannot establish one role learned a transferable protocol.

title: Split role training data by repository ancestry

donor_sources.observation: Trainset and devset are caller-supplied without repository ancestry or near-duplicate split enforcement.

mechanism: Split planner prevents source, episode, patch-family and generated-task leakage before role weight training.
challenge: Renamed copies, nearby commits and paraphrased tasks cannot cross into holdout without being detected.

title: Train recovery from REPL syntax and finalization errors

donor_sources.observation: The stream yields a final result only if a final prediction arrives, without a learned executable correction dataset.

mechanism: State-matched error/correction trajectories train role roots to repair code and finalize without fabricated observations.
challenge: Repaired syntax that silently drops required work or returns an undefined final variable remains incorrect.

title: Train asynchronous recursion policies without blocking input

donor_sources.observation: Two fixed asyncio.gather waves execute concurrently without a learned scheduler or explicit partial-outcome contract.

mechanism: Root adapters learn submit-await-cancel batching under host-enforced budgets and responsive asynchronous admission.
challenge: A policy cannot gain reward by dropping slow tasks, hiding errors or blocking terminal input during training.

title: Distill across roles without hiding negative transfer

donor_sources.observation: Reasoning methods are shared textual instructions, not separately trained role adapters with transfer measurement.

mechanism: Target-role adapters learn selected source-role root procedures while target and source competence are evaluated separately.
challenge: Transferring an aggressive proposer policy into a verifier can raise apparent productivity while increasing false acceptance.

title: Admit trained models with their native runtime generation

donor_sources.observation: The donor executes a binary against a goal but does not jointly validate trained-model and resident-code generations.

mechanism: Joint admission evaluates immutable model-adapter and native-code pairs under versioned execution contracts.
challenge: A trained model and new runtime that each pass alone can still form an incompatible pair and must be tested together.

title: Demonstrate every role training serving and improving

donor_sources.observation: The donor orchestrates fixed model roles but does not train and serve a distinct RLM adapter for each role.

mechanism: Bounded end-to-end demonstrator trains distinct role roots, serves exact artifacts and tests their code-improvement loop independently.
challenge: One shared unchanged model with different role prompts, or improvement measured only on training cases, fails the demonstration.
